title: A real project use case for final
answer: Constructor-injected dependencies are a practical final-reference use case. AeroTopo's `ProjectService` declares repository, GIS, configuration, and event-publisher dependencies as private final fields and assigns them once in the constructor. This prevents accidental reassignment after service construction and makes the dependency set stable for the object's lifetime. Final does not make those dependency objects themselves immutable; it only fixes which objects the fields reference.
